name: Page Specific Class
description: Page Specific Class intends to add class in body tag page-wise.
project_description:
Ability to add HTML attribute classes for CSS styling to the <body> tag based on path conditions. Specify body classes for pages by using their paths.

 Features

 
 Add different classes to the body tag of any page. 
 Support all Pages which can be created via Node, Views or Custom Route 
 
 How to use?

============

To learn more about the project and how to install and use it check out the README.txt. Feel free to report issues and by helping on the documentation pages.
